import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import os

# Suppress warnings
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Disable progress bars if any libraries have them

# Set random seeds for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Load data from input directory
print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

print(f"Training data shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test data shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Hold out validation set (20% of training data)
train_idx, val_idx = train_test_split(
    train_df.index, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=train_df["author"]
)
train_data = train_df.loc[train_idx]
val_data = train_df.loc[val_idx]

print(f"Train after split: {len(train_data)} samples")
print(f"Validation set: {len(val_data)} samples")


# Text preprocessing - lowercase and basic cleaning
def preprocess_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    text = str(text).lower()
    return text.replace("\n", " ").replace("\r", " ")


train_data["text_clean"] = train_data["text"].apply(preprocess_text)
val_data["text_clean"] = val_data["text"].apply(preprocess_text)
test_data = test_df.copy()  # FIX: Create test_data variable from test_df
test_data["text_clean"] = test_data["text"].apply(preprocess_text)

# Map authors to labels
author_map = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}
val_y = val_data["author"].map(author_map)
label_names = ["EAP", "HPL", "MWS"]

# Fit TF-IDF vectorizer
print("Vectorizing text...")
tfidf_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=10000,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    stop_words="english",
)
X_train_tfidf = tfidf_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_data["text_clean"])
X_val_tfidf = tfidf_vectorizer.transform(val_data["text_clean"])
X_test_tfidf = tfidf_vectorizer.transform(test_data["text_clean"])

# Train logistic regression classifier
print("Training model...")
clf = LogisticRegression(
    C=1.0, max_iter=1000, multi_class="multinomial", solver="lbfgs", random_state=42
)
clf.fit(X_train_tfidf, train_data["author"].map(author_map))

# Validate on held-out set
y_pred_proba_val = clf.predict_proba(X_val_tfidf)
log_loss_val = log_loss(val_y, y_pred_proba_val)
print(f"\nHold-out Validation Log Loss: {log_loss_val:.6f}")

# Get predictions for test set
print("\nGenerating submission...")
y_pred_proba_test = clf.predict_proba(X_test_tfidf)

# Create submission dataframe using sample submission template
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_data["id"],
        "EAP": y_pred_proba_test[:, 0],
        "HPL": y_pred_proba_test[:, 1],
        "MWS": y_pred_proba_test[:, 2],
    }
)

# Save submission to correct path
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv ({len(submission)} rows)")

# Also show some statistics
print(
    f"\nPrediction stats - EAP mean: {submission['EAP'].mean():.4f}, HPL mean: {submission['HPL'].mean():.4f}, MWS mean: {submission['MWS'].mean():.4f}"
)
